summary: RETEST after main agent fixed GET /api/internal-mail/{id} for broadcasts. Logged in as teacher sonia3009@gmail.com -> Portal Docente -> curso Historia -> MENSAJES. Clicking any message (broadcast OR normal) now opens the detail pane and the Gmail-style toolbar (data-testid='message-toolbar') is rendered. ALL toolbar visibility rules per spec PASSED: broadcast shows only Reply + Forward; normal shows Reply + ReplyAll + Forward + Delete + Archive + Mark. Reply/ReplyAll/Forward modals open with the correct title (Responder mensaje / Reenviar mensaje), correct subject prefix (Re:/Fwd:), correct recipient pre-fill (sender chip for reply, 0 chips for forward), and the quoted body containing 'escribió:' is injected into the TipTap editor. One MINOR regression: the inline 'border-left' style in the quote block is being stripped by TipTap's HTML sanitization, so the visual left-border cue is missing (text content of the quote is intact).

ui_bugs.issue: Inline 'style="border-left:3px solid #c7d2fe;padding-left:12px;..."' on the quoted <div> is stripped when TipTap parses the HTML via setContent. The quote text ('El <date>, <sender> escribió:' + original body) is preserved but the Gmail-style left border / muted color is not rendered. Confirmed via evaluate('document.querySelector(".ProseMirror").innerHTML') -> contains 'escribió' but NOT 'border-left'.

Missing data-testid on the Send button. get_by_role('button', name='Enviar') is ambiguous because toolbar-forward has title='Reenviar' which the accessibility tree also matches. Add data-testid='compose-send' for robust E2E testing.

issues: Quoted block lost its visual left-border styling vs the Gmail reference. Functionally OK, but UX is less clear that it is a quote.

rca of the issue: Confirmed the iter_210 BLOCKER is fixed: GET /api/internal-mail/{id} now returns 200 for broadcast IDs (verified by 'Responder mensaje' modal opening for the 'pruebqa' broadcast id 3b840282-...). New MINOR finding: buildQuotedBody returns HTML with inline 'style="border-left:3px solid #c7d2fe;padding-left:12px;margin-top:8px;color:#6b7280;"', but TipTap StarterKit's default schema does not preserve the 'style' attribute on <div>, so editor.getHTML() no longer contains 'border-left'. Mitigation: convert to <blockquote> (StarterKit Blockquote preserves it) or define a custom Quote extension with addAttributes({style: { default: null, parseHTML: el => el.getAttribute('style'), renderHTML: a => a.style ? {style: a.style} : {}}}).
